title: Void Explorer
description: Navigate a starship through a dense asteroid field. Blast cosmic obstacles, collect plasma shields, and survive as the speed intensifies! Highly responsive controls and explosive retro visuals.
controls: W/S/A/D or Arrows to Steer, Space to Shoot lasers.

title: Neon Snake Ultra
description: Feed the cyber-snake glowing light orbs to grow is length. Avoid crashing into glowing neon boundaries or your own laser tail. Features fluid particle trails and level speeds.
controls: Arrow keys or W/S/A/D to change direction.

title: 2048 Premium
description: Slide matching tiles on a grid to combine them. Unleash your logical planning to reach the elusive 2048 tile in this clean, dark-themed unblocked edition.
controls: Arrow keys or Swipe to slide tiles.

title: Grid Block Classic
description: Rotate and place falling geometric tetrominoes to clear horizontal rows. High-speed, unblocked, pure retro block satisfaction.
controls: A/D or Left/Right to slide, W or Up to rotate, S or Down to soft drop.

title: Chomp Man Arcade
description: Guide a glowing circle through neon blue corridors, swallowing yellow pellets while evading sneaky, colorful ghosts. Grab power pellets to strike back!
controls: W/S/A/D or Arrow Keys for quick turns.
